subject: Clean, Fast, All-Cash Offer for {{address}}
sections:
Good Day {{agent}},

Thank you for the opportunity to submit an all-cash offer for:

{{address}}
We understand the market is shifting — and today’s buyers are more selective than ever. What we’re offering is not just a price, but a promise: speed, certainty, and simplicity.
Our offer eliminates financing risk, appraisals, and endless negotiations. We are buying as-is and ready to move forward immediately.

Offer Summary:
Purchase Price: {{price}}
Close of Escrow: {{closeEscrow}}
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): {{emd}} — submitted upon acceptance and post-inspection
There are no banks involved. No appraisals. No buyer loan contingencies. This is a straight cash deal designed to make your seller’s life easier — not harder.
We’ve closed on deals like this throughout the region. If your client is ready to sell — not just list — we are here to execute.
If your client would like to counter, we’re happy to have a quick conversation. But we encourage keeping things streamlined and clean — just like the offer.
This Letter of Intent is non-binding and subject to the execution of a formal Purchase Agreement.
